corrections.before: The Hardy-Weinberg expected frequency of the homozygous genotype formed from allele p.
corrections.after: The Hardy–Weinberg expected frequency of AA, equal to p × p; p is the frequency of allele A, not an allele name.

corrections.before: The Hardy-Weinberg expected frequency of the homozygous genotype formed from allele q.
corrections.after: The Hardy–Weinberg expected frequency of aa, equal to q × q; q is the frequency of allele a, not an allele name.
